name: Sales
description: Independent persistent sales business module. Human authorization is required for approval and ecosystem publication.

fields.name: lines
fields.label: Requested merchandise lines (no accepted price yet)

actions.label: Request governed prices
actions.confirmation: Request prices from the approved Pricing provider using configured currency defaults? This does not accept an order.

actions.label: Poll current price authorization
actions.confirmation: Request fresh scoped price status from the original provider? This does not accept an order.

actions.label: Confirm with fresh price authorization
actions.confirmation: Authorize this bounded order confirmation intent? Acceptance requires fresh scoped Pricing receipts, current writer membership and verified compatible stock references.

actions.label: Cancel staged draft
actions.confirmation: Cancel this unaccepted draft? An accepted order must use its original Sales cancellation workflow.

actions.label: Request governed Catalog discovery
actions.confirmation: Read active offering metadata from the explicitly approved Catalog provider? This grants no price, stock or production authority.

actions.label: Refresh exact operational reference
actions.confirmation: Request a fresh exact offering and operational-reference read from this observation's original provider? Unsupported or ambiguous stock routing remains blocked.

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Human review reason (recorded now, not a recovered original receipt)

simulationEnabled.description: Explicitly permit dataset-scoped synthetic service commands. Normal records remain protected.

simulationPublicationEnabled.description: Allow authorized simulator publication of synthetic commerce analytics to Master.

governedSalesEnabled.description: Enable staged governed price requests and bounded human confirmation. Legacy manual orders remain independently available.

governedCatalogEnabled.description: Enable read-only governed Catalog discovery and exact operational-reference refresh for Sales.

catalogMaxAgeSeconds.description: Maximum age of exact Catalog observations, not continuing stock or price authority.

confirmationIntentSeconds.description: Maximum lifetime of a human confirmation intent awaiting fresh scoped Pricing authorization.

mcpTools.name: sales_listcustomer
mcpTools.description: Read authorized sales listCustomer; paginated module-owned evidence.

mcpTools.name: sales_listorder
mcpTools.description: Read authorized sales listOrder; paginated module-owned evidence.

mcpTools.name: sales_listfulfillment
mcpTools.description: Read authorized sales listFulfillment; paginated module-owned evidence.

mcpTools.name: sales_reports
mcpTools.description: Read authorized sales reports; paginated module-owned evidence.

mcpTools.name: sales_by_period
mcpTools.description: Revenue from actual completed fulfillments and order volume in UTC; from inclusive, to exclusive. Currencies remain separate.

mcpTools.name: sales_commerce_intelligence
mcpTools.description: Deterministic period merchandise profitability, fees, missing costs and product contribution; currencies separate.

mcpTools.name: sales_commerce_exceptions
mcpTools.description: Read-only fulfillment and missing-cost conditions; uncertain production requires reconciliation.
